hero.title: No more messy DMs. Collaborate with confidence.
hero.subtitle: KOLAB connects serious brands with vetted content creators in the DRC — with clear agreements, defined deliverables, and real professional respect from day one.

problem.label: The problem
problem.title: Finding a creator or brand today is harder than it should be.
problem.intro: In the DRC, collaborations between brands and creators still rely too heavily on DMs, WhatsApp groups, and word of mouth. It sometimes works — but it also creates real problems.

items.heading: No verification
items.body: Brands can't tell if a creator is reliable. Creators can't tell if a brand will actually pay.

items.heading: No clear agreements
items.body: Deliverables, deadlines, and usage rights are rarely written down. Misunderstandings are common and hard to resolve.

items.heading: No neutral framework
items.body: Without a platform in the middle, every collaboration starts from scratch. Professional relationships are hard to build on shaky ground.

problem.closing: The platform is built to change that — not with vague promises, but with a concrete, honest, and accessible framework.

brand.heading: Register your brand
brand.body: Tell us what you're looking for: your sector, rough budget, and the type of content you need. We review your profile before making any introductions.

brand.heading: Receive targeted suggestions
brand.body: We suggest creators who match your sector and goal. You review their profiles and decide who to move forward with.

brand.heading: Collaborate with clear terms
brand.body: Deliverables, deadlines, usage rights, and payment — all defined before work begins. No surprises, no misunderstandings.

creator.heading: Create your profile
creator.body: Share your work, your platforms, and your areas of focus. We verify your identity and portfolio before listing you.

creator.heading: Get matched with serious brands
creator.body: We introduce you only to brands that fit your niche and have expressed real, concrete needs.

creator.heading: Work within a professional framework
creator.body: Every collaboration starts with a written agreement: what's expected, by when, and how you'll be paid. Your work is respected.

collabTypes.label: Collaboration types
collabTypes.title: Several ways to work together.
collabTypes.subtitle: Every collaboration is different. Here are the forms it can take — and what each one means in practice.

items.heading: You create. The brand uses it.
items.body: You produce content (video, photo, copy) for a brand's use in their ads or communications. You don't need a large following — your creative skill is what matters.

items.heading: You publish to your own audience.
items.body: You share a brand's message with your audience on your Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube accounts. The reach of your community is your value.

items.heading: Both at once.
items.body: You create content AND publish it on your channels. This format combines both forms of value — creation and distribution.

items.heading: A product offered, not a payment.
items.body: A brand sends you a product in exchange for content or a mention. Important: gifting is not payment. Terms (what you deliver, when) are always agreed in advance. You are always free to accept or decline.

collabTypes.note: Whatever form the collaboration takes, terms are always agreed before work begins.

vetting.label: Our vetting process
vetting.title: What we verify — and what we don't claim to verify.
vetting.subtitle: We'd rather be precise than impressive. Here's exactly what we check for every creator we list.

levels.heading: Identity checked
levels.body: We confirm the person is real and that the information they provided matches. No full anonymity, no fake profiles.

levels.heading: Portfolio reviewed
levels.body: We look at concrete examples of their work. A UGC creator shows us content they've produced. An influencer shows us real posts.

levels.heading: Social accounts confirmed
levels.body: We confirm that the accounts listed belong to the creator. We do not verify audience statistics — those numbers can change, and we don't want to mislead you.

vetting.disclaimer: We don't claim to guarantee campaign results or creator performance. What we do stand behind is a serious framework and honest information.

promise.label: Our honest promise
promise.title: We're early stage. And we're telling you that.

items.heading: Matches are made by hand
items.body: At the start, we make introductions ourselves. It's not automated. It's slower, but it means we can be rigorous and learn what actually works.

items.heading: Payments are handled step by step
items.body: We're building a framework to make transactions safe. Right now, we walk you through exactly how each payment works and what is covered at each stage.

items.heading: We tell you what we don't do yet
items.body: We don't have all the answers. Rather than inventing certainty, we're transparent about what's still being built.

items.heading: Your trust is earned
items.body: We don't promise revenue or results. We promise seriousness, clarity, and a professional relationship that actually means something.

items.a: Joining the waitlist is completely free. Creators will not pay to be listed. The pricing structure for brands will be shared before launch — you'll hear about it first.
We're not giving a date we can't keep. People on the waitlist will be the first to know, and the first to be able to join the platform.

items.q: I'm a brand — can I choose my creators?
items.a: Yes. We suggest profiles, you review them and decide. You're never obligated to move forward with a suggestion.

items.q: I'm a creator — do I need a large following?
items.a: No. UGC creators don't need a large audience — their value is in their ability to produce great content. For influencer collaborations, audience matters, but quality and relevance come before numbers.
We're building a clear, step-by-step framework. Right now, we walk you through exactly how each transaction works and what's planned at each stage. We're not promising automatic or instant payment.

items.q: What happens if a collaboration goes wrong?
items.a: We're here. Because terms are defined and written in advance, problems are easier to resolve. We step in as a neutral party when needed. We'll explain the details of this process before any commitment is made.

items.q: I'm based outside Kinshasa. Can I still join?
items.a: Absolutely. We welcome creators and brands from across the DRC. Mention your city when you sign up — it helps us organise collaborations.
Your data is used only to manage the waitlist and contact you. It is never sold or shared with third parties. You can request deletion at any time by emailing us.
